note: Wildmoot Tusk (unit identity, Wildmoot): zombified piglin, biped, hunched; boar-kin with a snout and big white tusks, a riveted leather cap under the team headband, a shaggy hide mantle, a spiked leather pauldron over a strapped jerkin, a barry team kilt, team forearm wraps, shin guards and hooves. The crossbarred boar spear stands over the cap. Tier I only in the first pass. No back flag.
